titles.native: 宇宙戦艦ヤマト2205 新たなる旅立ち

description:
The sequel to "Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2202."

Note: Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2205 received a special theater screening as a movie duology with 4 episodes spliced together for each movie; "Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2205: Aratanaru Tabidachi - Zenshou - TAKE OFF -" and "Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2205: Aratanaru Tabidachi - Koushou -STASHA-."
